samples.question: Explain why my recent food history should not be treated as my complete meal history.
samples.reply: Phiq receives only a bounded recent excerpt of saved food history. Older saved entries can be outside that excerpt, so it cannot establish complete or all-time meal history. Daily totals are calculated separately from all saved entries for the selected day; unlogged food remains unknown.

samples.question: Explain the distinction between my saved Coach snapshot and my training preferences without guessing which is newer.
samples.reply:
Coach weekly program: Shows a saved weekly program based on account goals, training days, duration and equipment. 1. Open Coach and choose a training day/program.
2. Review its exercises, then start preparation.
3. Use Resume saved workout when an existing session is available.

Training preferences: Edits available equipment, training weekdays and session duration. These preferences influence saved Coach program versions.

1. Open Me, then Training preference.
2. Select equipment, days and duration.
3. Save, then open Coach to load the appropriate program.

samples.question: Why might my daily reminder fail to reach my phone even though it is enabled?
samples.reply:
Notifications and daily reminders: Lists account notices and unread state. Supports Mark all read and a daily check-in time in the device timezone. Phone push requires device permission and a configured server push provider.

1. Open Home, then Notifications.
2. Choose a reminder time and Save reminder, or Turn off.
3. Use Enable phone notifications on supported phone builds; review any delivery/setup message.

Open /home/notifications in PhysiqueQuest.

samples.question: Why can my saved completed workout not confirm the live state of my current session timer?
samples.reply:
Active workout and rest timer: Records reps and weights by set, supports skip/revisit, pause/resume, rest timers, and saving/ending the workout. Pounds entered in the UI are converted for saved kilogram loads. Only saved set results are confirmed; unsaved input drafts stay on the device.

1. Enter the set reps and load, then Save set.
2. Use rest controls, pause/resume or skip/revisit as needed.
3. Choose End session and confirm Save and end workout to create the report.

Open /coach/session in PhysiqueQuest.

samples.question: Why does my current Quest level not tell you my leaderboard position?
samples.reply:
Quests, missions, XP and badges: Derives daily missions, level, XP and streak from saved account activity. Workout earns 100 points, three meals 60, eight glasses of water 40, and a personal record 150. currentExp is earned within-level XP, totalExperience all-time XP, experienceToNextLevel remaining XP. Streak calculation currently caps at 365 days. Ranking-dependent badges are unavailable to the assistant.

1. Open Quests for level progress and current streak.
2. Review each daily mission’s progress and points.
3. Review earned/locked badges; unavailable badges are marked separately.

Open /quests in PhysiqueQuest.
